review_comments: Please double comfirm that since `UpdateCompareCols` is already called during `BuildWindowFunctionFrameBound`, is it necessary to call it again here.

> Please double comfirm that since `UpdateCompareCols` is already called during `BuildWindowFunctionFrameBound`, is it necessary to call it again here.

`UpdateCompareCols` is already called in `buildWindowFunctionFrameBound`, however, we need to call it again as the meta data in orderByCols may be changed.

> Return error if `len(fb.CalcFuncs) > 1`?

When sql is `select first_value(v) over (order by o1, o2);` it's frame type is range and len(fb.CalcFuncs) may be greater than 1.

> Ditto.

UpdateCompareCols is already called in buildWindowFunctionFrameBound, however, we need to call it again as the meta data in orderByCols may be changed.
Only need to handle the first orderByCols here

> Only need to handle the first orderByCols here

No, when sql is `select first_value(v) over (order by o1, o2);` it's frame type is range, so we need to handle all cols.
Add some tests for the datetime type

okk
